capabilities: run a pomodoro timer from the status bar or ribbon
configure durations, breaks, long-break intervals, and autostart
log finished pomodoros to a log file or daily note
show system notifications and play sounds or white noise
extras: README warns that system notifications may not work when Obsidian is installed via Flatpak on Linux, and notes that logging to the daily note only appends at the end of the file.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in pomodoro timer, so users must leave the app or use an external tool to track focused work sessions.
summary: Status bar pomodoro timer with configurable work/break durations, automatic cycling, session logging to notes, and system notifications.
